title: Bidirectional Mendelian randomization of gut microbial traits and erectile dysfunction with cross-cohort exposure validation and multiplicity control
description: Reproducible analysis code, versioned provenance records, multiplicity-controlled summary results, manuscript files, and submission-grade figures for a bidirectional Mendelian randomization reassessment of gut microbial traits and erectile dysfunction. Cross-cohort HUNT evidence is limited to exposure-association validation and exploratory sensitivity analysis; it is not independent MR replication. Third-party GWAS payloads are not redistributed.
